items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: So he left and he got Bill Johnson.

ctx.x: He said, "Yeah?" He said, "You're going to change your mind." "Oh, no," I said, "I ain't going to change my mind, Joe. I ain't going back to New York." So he kept on. Every day he'd come in and he'd say, "Well, we're leaving Monday. What do you say?" I'd say, "I give you my word, Joe. I'm not going back to New York." "I'm going to stay here." "Okay." So he left and he got Bill Johnson.
